opportunities.name: Hybrid sneeze caster
opportunities.objective: Test hybrid sneeze caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Achooo's champion explosion has 0.8 AP physical damage and MMOOOMMMM has 1.0 AP physical damage plus AP healing; Gunblade retains AD for Q/E and Shojin supports basic spell casts. Earned Muramana adds physical spell damage, with Serylda supporting that physical emphasis.
opportunities.requiredState: Land champion W explosions and R center while recording real Dragon Practice stacks.
opportunities.failure: Weak crit/Q progression and mana demand can lose sustained damage.
opportunities.test: Compare W/R damage and healing at equal earned stack counts.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP scaling does not make those W/R components magic or accelerate stacks without real hits.

opportunities.name: Scorcher health caster
opportunities.objective: Test scorcher health caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Super Scorcher Breath has an explicit crit-linked physical multiplier and later a stack-gated true burn; Essence Reaver provides one physical Spellblade if Q's interaction is confirmed. Shojin and Bloodmail emphasize repeated spell damage with health, while Cleaver assists physical packets.
opportunities.requiredState: Earn and record 25/125/225 stack thresholds through normal play.
opportunities.failure: Losing crit or reaching thresholds late ruins the damage plan.
opportunities.test: Compare Q before and after each threshold, counting Spellblade separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: No free 225 stacks, and armor reduction cannot amplify the true burn or execute threshold.

ruledOut.reason: AP scaling does not make those W/R components magic or accelerate stacks without real hits.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Hybrid sneeze caster
builds.summary: Test hybrid sneeze caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test hybrid sneeze caster against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Achooo's champion explosion has 0.8 AP physical damage and MMOOOMMMM has 1.0 AP physical damage plus AP healing; Gunblade retains AD for Q/E and Shojin supports basic spell casts. Earned Muramana adds physical spell damage, with Serylda supporting that physical emphasis.
testPlan: Required state: Land champion W explosions and R center while recording real Dragon Practice stacks.
Compare W/R damage and healing at equal earned stack counts.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak crit/Q progression and mana demand can lose sustained damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP scaling does not make those W/R components magic or accelerate stacks without real hits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge, Muramana, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing [60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing by [35]% for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing [10 / 35 / 60 / 85 / 110 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.8) × AP] physical + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_WDamageIncrease@ magic damage.

Smolder belches flame, dealing [(60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 + (1.3) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.75) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_QDamageIncrease@ magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds [15] Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:[25] Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.[125] Stacks: Sends [2 + (0.008) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] explosions beyond the target that deal [50]% of this Ability's damage.[225] Stacks: Burns the target, dealing [(0.00025) × AD[statFormula=2] + (5e-05) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] max Health true damage over [3] seconds. Enemy champions that drop below [(6.5) × (0.01)] total health while burning are killed instantly.

Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] physical damage. Enemies in the center take [(150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP) × (1.5)] physical damage instead and are Slowed by [40]% for [2] seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for [100 / 175 / 250 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.75) × AP] Health if she hits him.

Smolder takes flight, gaining [75]% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for [1.25] seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy [5 + (0.01) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] (rounded down) times for [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:EBonusDamage@ magic damage per hit.

Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with {{Spell_SmolderQ_Name}} grants a stack of {{Spell_SmolderP_Name}}, which improves Smolder's basic Abilities.
{{Spell_SmolderQ_Name}}: Deal an additional [((0.25) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})) × ((1 + ((1.4) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] magic damage and gain new effects at @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier1@, @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier2@, and @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier3@ stacks.{{Spell_SmolderW_Name}}: Explosions deal an additional [(0.55) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})] magic damage.{{Spell_SmolderE_Name}}: Each hit deals an additional [((0.08) × BuffStacks({32bcea5d})) × ((1 + ((0.75) × Stat(8)) × ((-1 + (1) × Stat(9)))))] magic damage and gain an extra bolt every [100] stacks.

Smolder has acquired Dragon Practice: @f1.0@.
